title: Cathedral of Christ the Saviour
visualBrief: Individual Banja Luka Cathedral of Christ the Saviour:stepped cross-plan church with four small corner domed drums and broad central gilded dome;alternating ochre/pink masonry bands share one graph. Ornate curved side gables have recessed portals,rose windows and sparse geometric white relief/tracery. Northwest low hipped-metal porch has three recessed doors/short steps;low wing links separate mapped tall striped clock tower with paired louvers,clocks,curved cornices and narrow estimated open octagonal bell crown/cap/cross. Actual whole and tower controls,four browser levels and five shared256-square graphs. Fine icons/interlace/lettering/interiors/engineering and exact ground joins simplified or unverified.
